tokens.name: bg-window
tokens.usage: egui window_fill: dialogs, popups, menus, tooltips, hover cards. Sits one step above bg-panel.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: egui panel_fill: top bar, right detail panel, map-control cluster. The default chrome ground.

tokens.name: bg-extreme
tokens.usage: egui extreme_bg_color: inside text fields, lists, the folder tree, scroll areas.

tokens.name: bg-faint
tokens.usage: egui faint_bg_color: striped table rows, subtle fills such as a section header band.

tokens.name: bg-code
tokens.usage: egui code_bg_color: inline paths and coordinates when they need a ground.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: egui strong_text_color: headings, the selected item's name, values the eye should land on. 14:1 on bg-panel in both themes.

tokens.name: text-normal
tokens.usage: egui text_color / override for body: body copy, metadata values, button labels. ≥9.7:1 on bg-panel, bg-window, bg-extreme, bg-faint in both themes.

tokens.name: text-weak
tokens.usage: egui weak_text_color: metadata labels, secondary lines, section headers, hints. ≥4.7:1 on bg-panel, bg-window, bg-extreme, bg-faint and accent-subtle in both themes. Not on hovered fills.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (WCAG exempts inactive controls). Never for information.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed fills. Dark ink on the dark theme's light accent (7:1), white on the light theme's deep accent (5.1:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, selection, checked controls, progress fill. As a mark ≥3:1 on every chrome ground in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover; also the focus ring (see border-strong).

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: egui selection.bg_fill: selected list/table row, highlighted dropdown row, selected segment. text-normal and text-weak stay legible on it.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: egui hyperlink_color. Underline on hover only. ≥4.9:1 on chrome grounds in both themes.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline panel separators, dialog title-bar rule, menu borders. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-normal
tokens.usage: Resting outline of text fields, checkboxes, number and path fields (≥3:1 on bg-panel and bg-extreme).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, drawn 1px outside the widget. ≥3.8:1 on every chrome ground.

tokens.name: widget-noninteractive-bg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.noninteractive.bg_fill. Labels, separators, frames that cannot be clicked.

tokens.name: widget-noninteractive-weak
tokens.usage: egui widgets.noninteractive.weak_bg_fill (button frames use this one).

tokens.name: widget-noninteractive-stroke
tokens.usage: egui widgets.noninteractive.bg_stroke colour (width: widget-noninteractive-stroke-width).

tokens.name: widget-noninteractive-fg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.noninteractive.fg_stroke: label, icon and check-mark colour in this state.

tokens.name: widget-inactive-bg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.inactive.bg_fill. Resting buttons, fields, checkboxes, sliders.

tokens.name: widget-inactive-weak
tokens.usage: egui widgets.inactive.weak_bg_fill (button frames use this one).

tokens.name: widget-inactive-stroke
tokens.usage: egui widgets.inactive.bg_stroke colour (width: widget-inactive-stroke-width).

tokens.name: widget-inactive-fg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.inactive.fg_stroke: label, icon and check-mark colour in this state.

tokens.name: widget-hovered-bg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.hovered.bg_fill. Pointer over an interactive widget; grows 1px (expansion).

tokens.name: widget-hovered-weak
tokens.usage: egui widgets.hovered.weak_bg_fill (button frames use this one).

tokens.name: widget-hovered-stroke
tokens.usage: egui widgets.hovered.bg_stroke colour (width: widget-hovered-stroke-width).

tokens.name: widget-hovered-fg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.hovered.fg_stroke: label, icon and check-mark colour in this state.

tokens.name: widget-active-bg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.active.bg_fill. Mouse button down on the widget (egui also uses it while a widget has focus: add the focus ring on top).

tokens.name: widget-active-weak
tokens.usage: egui widgets.active.weak_bg_fill (button frames use this one).

tokens.name: widget-active-stroke
tokens.usage: egui widgets.active.bg_stroke colour (width: widget-active-stroke-width).

tokens.name: widget-active-fg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.active.fg_stroke: label, icon and check-mark colour in this state.

tokens.name: widget-open-bg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.open.bg_fill. A combo box or menu button whose popup is open.

tokens.name: widget-open-weak
tokens.usage: egui widgets.open.weak_bg_fill (button frames use this one).

tokens.name: widget-open-stroke
tokens.usage: egui widgets.open.bg_stroke colour (width: widget-open-stroke-width).

tokens.name: widget-open-fg
tokens.usage: egui widgets.open.fg_stroke: label, icon and check-mark colour in this state.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success icon and text. Import finished, source online, file found. ≥4.5:1 on bg-panel, bg-window, bg-extreme, bg-faint and on status-success-subtle in both themes; always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of success toasts, banners and chips.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon and text. Partial import, photos without GPS, slow tiles. ≥4.5:1 on bg-panel, bg-window, bg-extreme, bg-faint and on status-warning-subtle in both themes; always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of warning toasts, banners and chips.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error icon and text. Failed import, missing file, unreadable EXIF. ≥4.5:1 on bg-panel, bg-window, bg-extreme, bg-faint and on status-error-subtle in both themes; always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-error-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of error toasts, banners and chips.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info icon and text. Neutral news: an update, a tip, a background task. ≥4.5:1 on bg-panel, bg-window, bg-extreme, bg-faint and on status-info-subtle in both themes; always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-info-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of info toasts, banners and chips.

tokens.name: status-offline
tokens.usage: Offline icon and text. Tile server or photo source unreachable. Deliberately grey: offline is a state, not an alarm. ≥4.5:1 on bg-panel, bg-window, bg-extreme, bg-faint and on status-offline-subtle in both themes; always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-offline-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of offline toasts, banners and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Colour of the modal-dialog shadow (elevation-modal).

tokens.name: shadow-popup
tokens.usage: Colour of popup, tooltip and panel-over-map shadows.

tokens.name: map-marker-frame
tokens.usage: 2px frame around every photo thumbnail and its pointer.

tokens.name: map-marker-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outer edge outside the frame: separates a white frame from pale land and white roads (≥5:1 on every tile colour).

tokens.name: map-marker-frame-selected
tokens.usage: 3px frame of the selected marker; keep map-marker-edge outside it so it holds on water and motorways.

tokens.name: map-marker-placeholder
tokens.usage: Thumbnail ground while the preview is still being generated.

tokens.name: map-marker-placeholder-fg
tokens.usage: Image icon on map-marker-placeholder (3.0:1).

tokens.name: map-marker-missing
tokens.usage: Thumbnail ground when the file is missing on disk.

tokens.name: map-marker-missing-fg
tokens.usage: Image-off icon on map-marker-missing (4.8:1).

tokens.name: map-pin
tokens.usage: Pointer tip dot that marks the exact GPS position; drawn with a 1px map-marker-frame ring.

tokens.name: map-badge-bg
tokens.usage: Group count badge fill; ≥7.5:1 against every tile colour, including motorways.

tokens.name: map-badge-text
tokens.usage: Count on map-badge-bg (17:1). Badge carries a 1.5px map-marker-frame ring.

tokens.name: map-cluster-halo
tokens.usage: Translucent disc behind a hovered group, sized to the area the group covers.

tokens.name: map-selection-outline
tokens.usage: 2px outline drawn around a selected group or the strip's selected thumbnail; always with map-marker-edge outside.

tokens.name: map-scrim-dark
tokens.usage: Ground for light text drawn over the map: the group strip, drag hints.

tokens.name: map-scrim-dark-text
tokens.usage: Text on map-scrim-dark (≥13:1 over any tile).

tokens.name: map-scrim-light
tokens.usage: Ground for the attribution and the scale bar, OSM convention.

tokens.name: map-scrim-light-text
tokens.usage: Attribution and scale-bar text on map-scrim-light (≥11:1 over any tile).

tokens.name: map-ref-land
tokens.usage: Reference only, approximating OSM Carto tiles in mockups. Never paint chrome with map-ref tokens.

tokens.name: map-ref-water
tokens.usage: Reference only: OSM water.

tokens.name: map-ref-park
tokens.usage: Reference only: OSM parks.

tokens.name: map-ref-forest
tokens.usage: Reference only: OSM woodland.

tokens.name: map-ref-motorway
tokens.usage: Reference only: OSM motorway, the most saturated tile colour overlays must survive.

tokens.name: map-ref-trunk
tokens.usage: Reference only: OSM trunk road.

tokens.name: map-ref-road
tokens.usage: Reference only: OSM minor road.

tokens.name: map-ref-building
tokens.usage: Reference only: OSM buildings.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: item-spacing-x

tokens.name: item-spacing-y
tokens.usage: egui spacing.item_spacing.y: vertical gap between rows.

tokens.name: button-padding-x
tokens.usage: egui spacing.button_padding.x.

tokens.name: button-padding-y
tokens.usage: egui spacing.button_padding.y; with Button text (16px row) gives the 24px height.

tokens.name: indent

tokens.name: interact-height

tokens.name: interact-height-sm

tokens.name: menu-margin

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, toggle tracks, slider handles, the pin dot (half the short side).

shadow.note: Each elevation is one egui Shadow: offset, blur, spread, colour. No other shadows.

tokens.name: elevation-popup
tokens.usage: Level 1: menus, dropdowns, tooltips, hover cards, toasts. egui popup_shadow {offset [0,4], blur 12, spread 0, colour shadow-popup}.

tokens.name: elevation-panel
tokens.usage: Level 2: chrome floating over the map (map controls, the strip, the right panel's left edge). {offset [0,2], blur 8, spread 0}.

tokens.name: elevation-modal
tokens.usage: Level 3: modal dialogs. egui window_shadow {offset [0,12], blur 32, spread 0, colour shadow-window}.

tokens.name: elevation-marker
tokens.usage: Photo marker resting on the tiles (fixed: the map is always light).

tokens.name: elevation-marker-raised
tokens.usage: Photo marker on hover.
